name: Sentinel MCP Server
description: Sentinel is an enterprise-grade security server that integrates tools like Semgrep, Trivy, and Gitleaks via Docker to perform automated vulnerability scanning and compliance checks. It enables users to conduct static analysis, secret detection, and AI-powered threat modeling directly through Model Context Protocol-compatible IDEs.
